```{r panel-description, echo=FALSE}
description <- "
Panel H: Male-specific subtypes carry the pheromone-to-P1 inhibitory pathway
=============================================================================
Left:  Paired box plots comparing male-specific vs shared mAL subtypes for:
       - ppk input strength (top) -- direct synaptic weight
       - P1 output strength (bottom) -- direct synaptic weight

Right: Dot plot summary -- all mAL subtypes as rows, columns = dimorphism class,
       fru/dsx expression, NT prediction, ppk23 input, ppk25 input, P1 output

Key finding: Male-specific mAL_m subtypes receive stronger ppk input AND project
more heavily to P1, indicating the pheromone-to-courtship inhibitory pathway is
sexually dimorphic.

Data source: Direct synaptic connectivity from the connectome.
"
pdir <- panel_plot_dir("panel_H_description", "txt")
writeLines(description, file.path(pdir, "panel_H_description.txt"))
cat(description)
```

## Split mAL types by dimorphism class

```{r dimorphism-split}
# Use mal_dimorphism from setup.R (male_specific vs shared)
male_specific_mal <- mal_subtypes[mal_dimorphism[mal_subtypes] == "male_specific"]
shared_mal <- mal_subtypes[mal_dimorphism[mal_subtypes] == "shared"]

cat("Total mAL types:", length(mal_subtypes), "\n")
cat("Male-specific:", length(male_specific_mal), "\n")
cat("Shared:", length(shared_mal), "\n")
```

## Compute ppk input strength (direct synaptic + path-based)

```{r ppk-input}
ppk23_types <- channel_neurons[["ppk23"]]
ppk25_types <- channel_neurons[["ppk25"]]

# Direct synaptic input from ppk sensory neurons to all mAL types
ppk_direct <- conn %>%
  filter(pre_type %in% c(ppk23_types, ppk25_types),
         post_type %in% mal_subtypes) %>%
  mutate(channel = ifelse(pre_type %in% ppk23_types, "ppk23", "ppk25")) %>%
  group_by(post_type, channel) %>%
  summarise(input = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = channel, values_from = input,
              names_prefix = "direct_", values_fill = 0) %>%
  rename(type = post_type)

# Build combined data frame
# Ensure both ppk columns exist (pivot_wider only creates columns for channels present)
if (!"direct_ppk23" %in% colnames(ppk_direct)) ppk_direct$direct_ppk23 <- 0
if (!"direct_ppk25" %in% colnames(ppk_direct)) ppk_direct$direct_ppk25 <- 0

ppk_all <- data.frame(type = mal_subtypes, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(ppk_direct, by = "type") %>%
  mutate(
    direct_ppk23 = replace_na(direct_ppk23, 0),
    direct_ppk25 = replace_na(direct_ppk25, 0),
    total_ppk_direct = direct_ppk23 + direct_ppk25,
    # Path-based strengths from activation matrix
    path_ppk23 = mal_activation_matrix[type, "ppk23"],
    path_ppk25 = mal_activation_matrix[type, "ppk25"],
    total_ppk_path = abs(path_ppk23) + abs(path_ppk25),
    dimorphism = mal_dimorphism[type],
    nt = mal_nt[type]
  )

cat("ppk input summary by dimorphism:\n")
print(ppk_all %>%
  group_by(dimorphism) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_direct_ppk = mean(total_ppk_direct),
    mean_path_ppk = mean(total_ppk_path),
    .groups = "drop"
  ))
```

## Compute P1 output strength for all mAL types

```{r p1-output}
mal_to_p1_all <- conn %>%
  filter(pre_type %in% mal_subtypes, post_type %in% p1_subtypes) %>%
  group_by(pre_type) %>%
  summarise(p1_output = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ppk_all <- ppk_all %>%
  left_join(mal_to_p1_all, by = c("type" = "pre_type")) %>%
  mutate(p1_output = replace_na(p1_output, 0))
```

## Paired box plots: male-specific vs shared

```{r box-plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
p_ppk_direct <- ggplot(ppk_all, aes(x = dimorphism, y = total_ppk_direct, fill = dimorphism)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dimorphism_colors) +
  labs(x = "Dimorphism class",
       y = "Direct ppk synaptic input\n(synapse count)") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_ppk_path <- ggplot(ppk_all, aes(x = dimorphism, y = total_ppk_path, fill = dimorphism)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dimorphism_colors) +
  labs(x = "Dimorphism class",
       y = "Path-based ppk strength\n(|ppk23| + |ppk25|)") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_p1_box <- ggplot(ppk_all, aes(x = dimorphism, y = p1_output, fill = dimorphism)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dimorphism_colors) +
  labs(x = "Dimorphism class",
       y = "P1 output strength\n(synapse count)") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_box_combined <- (p_ppk_direct | p_ppk_path) / p_p1_box +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")

save_fig5_plot(p_box_combined, "panel_H_dimorphism_boxplots", width = 10, height = 10)
print(p_box_combined)
```

## Summary dot plot

```{r dot-summary, fig.width=10, fig.height=14}
dot_summary <- ppk_all %>%
  arrange(dimorphism, desc(total_ppk_direct)) %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = type))

dot_long <- dot_summary %>%
  select(type, dimorphism, direct_ppk23, direct_ppk25, p1_output) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(direct_ppk23, direct_ppk25, p1_output),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric,
                         levels = c("direct_ppk23", "direct_ppk25", "p1_output"),
                         labels = c("ppk23 input", "ppk25 input", "P1 output")))

p_dot <- ggplot(dot_long %>% filter(value > 0),
                aes(x = metric, y = type)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = value, color = metric)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 6), name = "Synapse count") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("ppk23 input" = "#FFD92F",
                                "ppk25 input" = "#E5C494",
                                "P1 output" = "#984EA3"),
                     name = "Metric") +
  facet_grid(dimorphism ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Connectivity metric", y = "mAL type") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, color = "grey90")
  )

save_fig5_plot(p_dot, "panel_H_summary_dot_plot", width = 10, height = 14)
print(p_dot)
```

## Statistical tests

```{r stats}
if (length(unique(ppk_all$dimorphism)) > 1) {
  test_ppk_direct <- wilcox.test(total_ppk_direct ~ dimorphism, data = ppk_all)
  test_ppk_path   <- wilcox.test(total_ppk_path ~ dimorphism, data = ppk_all)
  test_p1         <- wilcox.test(p1_output ~ dimorphism, data = ppk_all)
  cat("Wilcoxon test - direct ppk input: p =", format(test_ppk_direct$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
  cat("Wilcoxon test - path ppk input:   p =", format(test_ppk_path$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
  cat("Wilcoxon test - P1 output:        p =", format(test_p1$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
} else {
  cat("Only one dimorphism class present in data\n")
  test_ppk_direct <- test_ppk_path <- test_p1 <- list(p.value = NA)
}
```

## Panel narrative

```{r narrative, echo=FALSE}
n_male_specific <- sum(ppk_all$dimorphism == "male_specific")
n_shared <- sum(ppk_all$dimorphism == "shared")

mean_ppk_direct_male <- mean(ppk_all$total_ppk_direct[ppk_all$dimorphism == "male_specific"])
mean_ppk_direct_shared <- mean(ppk_all$total_ppk_direct[ppk_all$dimorphism == "shared"])
mean_ppk_path_male <- mean(ppk_all$total_ppk_path[ppk_all$dimorphism == "male_specific"])
mean_ppk_path_shared <- mean(ppk_all$total_ppk_path[ppk_all$dimorphism == "shared"])
mean_p1_male <- mean(ppk_all$p1_output[ppk_all$dimorphism == "male_specific"])
mean_p1_shared <- mean(ppk_all$p1_output[ppk_all$dimorphism == "shared"])

ppk_direct_fold <- ifelse(mean_ppk_direct_shared > 0, mean_ppk_direct_male / mean_ppk_direct_shared, Inf)
ppk_path_fold <- ifelse(mean_ppk_path_shared > 0, mean_ppk_path_male / mean_ppk_path_shared, Inf)
p1_fold <- ifelse(mean_p1_shared > 0, mean_p1_male / mean_p1_shared, Inf)

ppk_direct_p <- ifelse(!is.na(test_ppk_direct$p.value),
                       format(test_ppk_direct$p.value, digits = 3), "N/A")
ppk_path_p <- ifelse(!is.na(test_ppk_path$p.value),
                     format(test_ppk_path$p.value, digits = 3), "N/A")
p1_p_text <- ifelse(!is.na(test_p1$p.value),
                    format(test_p1$p.value, digits = 3), "N/A")

top_ppk_male <- ppk_all %>%
  filter(dimorphism == "male_specific") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_ppk_direct)) %>%
  head(3) %>%
  pull(type)

narrative <- sprintf(
"PANEL H: Sexual Dimorphism -- Male-Specific Pheromone-to-P1 Pathway
=====================================================================

WHAT THIS PANEL SHOWS
---------------------
Box plots comparing male-specific (%d subtypes) vs shared (%d subtypes):
  - Direct ppk synaptic input (synapse count)
  - Path-based ppk strength (multi-hop path analysis)
  - P1 output strength (synapse count to P1 courtship neurons)

Dot plot: all mAL types as rows, columns = ppk23 input, ppk25 input,
P1 output, faceted by dimorphism class.

KEY OBSERVATIONS
----------------
1. Direct ppk input: male-specific %.1fx stronger (Wilcoxon p = %s).
   Path-based ppk: male-specific %.1fx stronger (p = %s).

2. P1 output: male-specific %.1fx stronger (p = %s).

3. Top ppk-receiving male-specific subtypes: %s.

BIOLOGICAL INTERPRETATION
-------------------------
The pheromone-to-courtship inhibitory pathway is sexually dimorphic.
Male-specific mAL subtypes receive strong pheromone input AND project
heavily to P1, using primarily GABAergic neurotransmission. Shared
mAL types participate in non-pheromone circuits.
",
n_male_specific, n_shared,
ppk_direct_fold, ppk_direct_p,
ppk_path_fold, ppk_path_p,
p1_fold, p1_p_text,
paste(top_ppk_male, collapse = ", ")
)

save_panel_narrative("panel_H", narrative)
cat(narrative)
```
